name: DetailsPage
title: Templates/Platform/Detail/DetailsPage
summary: The summary card that opens a resource Overview tab: a subject band with the primary link and the actions, a band of labelled facts, and a state band on the canvas fill. It comes in three shapes — a resource, a service with its domains and environments, and a policy — each with its own facts and copy. Built from `Card`, `Button`, `IconButton`, `DropdownMenu`, `Popover`, `Tag`, `StatusIndicator`, `Avatar`, `CopyButton`, `Accordion`, `Alert` and `Tooltip`.

variants.name: Service
variants.summary: The service summary: the domain with its aliases in the overflow popover, the environment menu (shown below md only; from md up the breadcrumb carries the environment) and actions, the custom domains, status, service ID and creation, and the shared Deployment Settings band that expands into its policies.

variants.name: Policy
variants.summary: The policy summary: the resource it protects, a Rules shortcut and actions, then status, environment, rule count, last edit and the enabled modules, and what the policy inspects.
